# Varaha Jewels

> Varaha Jewels (varahajewels.in) is an online Indian jewellery store from Jaipur, Rajasthan, founded by Aditya Chitoshiya and Shivangi. It sells fashion and festive jewellery and accessories: Kundan and American Diamond necklace sets, earrings, 925 sterling silver pendants, rudraksha malas, women's watches and potli bags, delivered across India.

## Founders
- Aditya Chitoshiya, Co-founder of Varaha Jewels
- Shivangi, Co-founder of Varaha Jewels

## What we sell
- [Heritage collection](https://www.varahajewels.in/heritage): American Diamond (AD) and Polki-look necklace sets for weddings and festivals
- [Kundan necklace sets](https://www.varahajewels.in/women/necklaces): gold-plated Kundan sets
- [Earrings](https://www.varahajewels.in/women/earrings): Kundan and Meenakari earrings
- [925 Silver](https://www.varahajewels.in/silver): 925 sterling silver pendants, some gold-plated with CZ stones
- [Divine](https://www.varahajewels.in/divine): rudraksha mala chain necklaces with Om, Trishul, Ganesha and Shiva pendants
- [Watches](https://www.varahajewels.in/watches): Kundan party-wear and rose-gold women's watches
- [Potli bags](https://www.varahajewels.in/potli-bags): potli bags and metal Kundan clutches
- [Shop everything](https://www.varahajewels.in/shop)

## Policies
- Free delivery on orders of ₹499 and above, across India
- Cash on delivery available
- 7-day returns and exchange: [shipping and returns](https://www.varahajewels.in/shipping)
- Secure online payment by UPI, card or net banking
